examples.title: Average by deviation
steps: The deviations are +3, -1, +8, -4 and +4, which add to +10.

examples.title: Adding, removing or replacing a member
examples.problem: The average of 12 numbers is 25. When a 13th number is added, the average becomes 26. What is the 13th number?

examples.title: Weighted average
examples.problem: 25 students have an average mark of 70 and 15 students have an average mark of 78. What is the average mark of all 40?
steps: The average lies 3/8 of the way from 70 to 78: 3/8 × 8 = 3.

examples.title: Alligation
examples.problem: Wheat at ₹28 per kg is mixed with wheat at ₹36 per kg to get a mixture worth ₹31 per kg. In what ratio are they mixed?

examples.title: Repeated replacement
examples.problem: A 27 litre jar is full of pure juice. 9 litres are taken out and replaced with water, and this is done once more. How much juice is left?
steps: Each step keeps 1 - 9/27 = 2/3 of the juice.
